description: This file implements a performance tracing target for Git trace2, defining functions for formatting and writing trace lines, handling various events such as start, exit, signals, commands, and data, and configuring trace behavior.

methods.name: int fn_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the performance trace target, determining if tracing is wanted and setting up brief format preference based on environment variables.

methods.name: void fn_term(void)
methods.description: Terminates the performance trace target by disabling tracing.

methods.name: void perf_fmt_prepare(const char * event_name,struct tr2tls_thread_ctx * ctx,const char * file,int line,const struct repository * repo,uint64_t * p_us_elapsed_absolute,uint64_t * p_us_elapsed_relative,const char * category,struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Formats the prefix of a trace line in human-readable format, including timestamp, thread info, event name, repository, timing, category, and indentation.

methods.name: void perf_io_write_fl(const char * file,int line,const char * event_name,const struct repository * repo,uint64_t * p_us_elapsed_absolute,uint64_t * p_us_elapsed_relative,const char * category,const struct strbuf * buf_payload)
methods.description: Writes a formatted trace line with event details, including payload data.
